capabilities: Expands embedded notes up to depth 3.
Delivers EPUB to Kindle via Amazon endpoints.
disambiguation: This is an unofficial integration using undocumented internal Amazon endpoints and is not endorsed by Amazon.
extras: This is an unofficial integration against internal Amazon services and may carry risks regarding Amazon's terms of service.
intentEvidence: Send your Obsidian notes to your Kindle as EPUB, straight from the Obsidian desktop app.
problem: Users need a reliable way to export and deliver their detailed Obsidian notes to their Kindle device.

relations.evidence: Releases before 0.1.2 shipped under the plugin id and install folder send-to-kindle.

summary: Converts current Obsidian notes into EPUB format and delivers them to Amazon Kindle via an unofficial desktop integration.
